description: Σημεία Ελεύθερης Πρόσβασης στο Διαδίκτυο του Δήμου Πολυγύρου (WiFi4GR) is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Δήμος Πολυγύρου. Γεωγραφική αποτύπωση των σημείων ασύρματης πρόσβασης στο διαδίκτυο (Wi-Fi) στα όρια του Δήμου Πολυγύρου (WiFi4GR). Coverage: Δήμος Πολυγύρου. The portal shows the English title as "Public Free WiFi Points of the Municipality of Polygyros (WiFi4GR)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Δήμος Πολυγύρου. Its keywords include wifi4gr, GIS, hotspots, KML, WiFi. The listing shows 1 download or service links in KML. The listing shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
